content.value: The Oban Worker that materializes extracted edges into the Content Edges Table, mirroring the Indx IndexerWorker on the search side.

is the write-side of the Content Graph. It collects the edges produced by every plugin's Edge Extractor, then upserts them into the Content Edges Table so that Graph Traversal, Blast Radius, and the Graph View read materialized rows instead of recomputing edges on every request. It is structurally a twin of the Indx
from the Indx Engine — same async, same idempotent-rebuild shape — which is exactly what you'd expect from the dual of the Indx Retriever Seam.

rather than touching every tenant at once. This guards multi-tenant isolation — no accidental cross-workspace edge wipe.

Running as an Oban Worker gives the projector retries, uniqueness, and back-pressure for free, and keeps the Mutation hot path cheap: a Document write enqueues a projection job and returns, rather than computing edges synchronously. The same pattern is what keeps Postgres Search indexing off the request path — re-projecting edges after a write is one of the background jobs Operations leans on to keep every surface consistent.
The projector writes into FK-constrained columns, so a Dangling Reference physically cannot be persisted as an edge — those surface later as Phantom Nodes at read time, never as stored rows.
